canonicality_analysis.summary: There is currently NO single canonical source of truth for geography. The backend serves static TypeScript files, the mobile app queries a 137 MB shipped SQLite database, the database schema is almost completely unpopulated (0 constituencies, 0 mandals), and the web admin displays hardcoded mock data. State counts range from 16 to 36 across subsystems.

temporal_and_versioning_analysis.effective_dates_in_db: Missing effective_from, effective_to, is_active, version, and boundary_regime on official geography tables

scenario_vs_official_isolation.findings: Delimitation simulation tables (delimitation_proposals, proposed_constituencies, constituency_mapping) are isolated in Migration 011. However, Fastify route /api/v1/delimitation/simulate operates entirely in-memory using static 2011 Census JSON data, completely bypassing PostgreSQL.

temporal_and_versioning_analysis.w013_vs_w014_boundary: W013 establishes the canonical geography entities, codes, and static schema. W014 will introduce temporal bounds, versioning, delimitation regimes (1976 vs 2008 vs post-2026), and effective date intervals. W013 MUST include nullable temporal scaffold columns (effective_from, effective_to, is_active) to avoid schema breakage in W014.

structure.administrative_tree: Country -> State/UT -> District (MISSING IN DB) -> Revenue Division -> Mandal/Tehsil -> Revenue Village / Gram Panchayat -> Habitation/Ward
structure.electoral_tree: Country -> Parliamentary Constituency (MISSING IN DB) -> Assembly Constituency -> Polling Booth (Section/Part)
structure.urban_local_governance: State/UT -> District -> Urban Local Body (Municipal Corp / Municipality / Nagar Panchayat) -> ULB Ward
structure.rural_local_governance: State/UT -> Zilla Parishad (District) -> Mandal Parishad (Block) -> Gram Panchayat -> GP Ward

intersection_complexity.mandal_to_ac_relationship: MANY-TO-MANY (M:N). A mandal may be split across 2 or more Assembly Constituencies, and an AC contains parts of multiple mandals. Migration 022 created 'mandal_constituency_map' with 'overlap_type' (full, partial), but 0 rows are populated.
intersection_complexity.district_to_ac_relationship: PREDOMINANTLY 1:N but occasionally M:N across state administrative reorganizations.
intersection_complexity.pc_to_ac_relationship: STRICT 1:N within state boundaries (each AC belongs to exactly one PC under ECI delimitation orders).

findings.description: Database geography tables are completely empty in staging (0 constituencies, 0 mandals, 0 local bodies, 0 polling booths). Only 20 state rows exist.
State count discrepancy: DB has 20 states, Seed has 31 states, GeoJSON has 32 states, Shared library has 36 states, Web admin has 16 states.
Districts and Parliamentary Constituencies have NO tables in PostgreSQL schema. They are modeled as unnormalized TEXT strings or integers.
Mobile app stores 'acNo: number' without stateCode in myConstituency store, causing cross-state constituency ID collision.
Mobile aiService queries non-existent columns 'district_name, reservation_type, total_electors' from constituencies table (actual columns: district, reservation, total_voters), failing at runtime.
Mobile app ships with a 137 MB SQLite database (seed-data.db), creating an unmaintainable client-side divergence from backend and DB.
GeoJSON manifest has 9 states marked as placeholder with hasPolygons=false (PY, TR, ML, MN, NL, UK, SK, AR, MZ).
Web admin hardcodes mock constituency data with synthetic non-canonical identifiers like 'TS-PC-09'.

security_and_rls_analysis.current_state: All geography tables in Migration 001, 011, 022, and 023 have RLS enabled with permissive public read access (FOR SELECT USING (true)).
security_and_rls_analysis.mutation_security: No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies exist for public/authenticated users. Only service_role can mutate geography data.
security_and_rls_analysis.w013_security_plan: Maintain public read access for all canonical geography entities. Restrict all DDL/DML mutation strictly to service_role and verified data governance migration pipelines.

performance_implications.current_status: Hot-path performance benchmark in W012 demonstrated ~2 ms server-side latency on PostgreSQL staging queries.
proposed_index_strategy: GIST spatial indexes on boundary columns
performance_implications.no_speculative_indexing: Indexes will be introduced strictly to support known primary key, foreign key, and traversal lookups.
